ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh, loli innit. Niiice ain't they, lolis. I wish I had met you then!"

rows.jp: 「リ、リアルな顔になってるんですけど……」

ghs.en: Miki: "B-, but you're making a pretty Real Serious face now..."

rows.jp: 「リアルに欲しいからな。いくらだ？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because I want them for Real. How much?"

rows.jp: 「そういえば……唇……奪いましたね？」
rows.en: “Come to think of it... you stole a kiss from me, didn’t you?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Speaking of that... my lips... you stole them didn't you."

rows.jp: 「う……ああ、あの件ね。いや、あまりに絶妙のタイミングでキックが入ったから、ちょっとヒートしてしまって」
rows.en: “Ugh... yes, that. Your kick landed with such exquisite timing that I got a little heated.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ngh... aaah, that thing, yes. No, it's just that the kick you gave me had with such an exquisite timing, and there was a little heat..."

rows.jp: 「ファーストキスだったのに……」

ghs.en: Miki: "And it was my first kiss too..."
Taichi: "It-, it did feel like it."

rows.jp: 「しかし美希があまりにも鋭い攻撃を放ったため、俺の心はホット入ったのである」
rows.en: “But your attack was so sharp, it knocked my heart from HEATED straight into HOT.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Still, Miki, you burned up my heart because you unleashed an attack so very sharp, indeed!"

rows.jp: しばらく美希はうーうー唸っていた。
rows.en: Miki sits there growling for a while.

ghs.en: For a while, Miki just muttered all 'ngh, ngh'.

rows.jp: 「……犬に噛まれたものと思って諦めるしか……」
rows.en: “...I suppose I’ll have to write it off as a dog bite...”

ghs.en: Miki: "...I must give up and consider this as if having been bitten by a stray dog, with no owner that a law could judge..."

rows.jp: 「それかこのカメラの内容を公開してウサをはらすか」
rows.en: “Or I could make myself feel better by publishing what’s on this camera.”

ghs.en: Miki: "So, should I forget my troubles by exposing the contents of this camera to the world?"

rows.jp: 「そ、それは使い捨てカメラッ！？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "I-, is that a disposable camera?!"
Miki: "Is that the part that surprises you now..."

rows.jp: 「先輩のぞうさんです。２４枚撮りきりました」
rows.en: “Your elephant. I used all twenty-four shots.”

rows.jp: 俺の恥ずかしい茎、恥茎(ちけい)をっ！

ghs.en:
My Embarrassing Stem is getting EmbaStem'd!"
* EmbaStem'd = flogged.

rows.jp: 「掲示板にぃ、貼りだしちゃおうかな～、そ　れ　と　も、ばらまいちゃおうかな～♪」
rows.en: “Maybe I’ll pin them to the bulletin board. Or maaaybe... scatter them everywhere~♪”

ghs.en: Miki: "Should I stick theee～m, on a notice board, or-in-its-stead, maybe I'll scatter it arooo～und♪!"

rows.jp: 「や、やめておくれ、それだけは」

ghs.en: Taichi: "S-, stop I beg, that's insane!"

rows.jp: 「んー、ファーストキス奪われちゃったしなー。やっぱ公開かなー」
rows.en: “Hmm. You did steal my first kiss. Maybe I should publish them after all.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Hmmm, my first kiss's been stolen wasn't iiit. Indeed this has to be made public don't iiit."

rows.jp: 「わたしの言うことを聞きますか？」

ghs.en: Miki: "Will you do what I tell you to do?"

rows.en: I rub my hands together obsequiously.

rows.jp: 「じゃあ言うことを一つきくごとに、写真を一枚ずつ返してあげましょう」
rows.en: “Then each time you obey one order, I’ll return one photograph.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Then for each thing I order you to do that you actually do, I will return you one picture."

rows.jp: 「そんなエロゲみたいな要求にも、この黒須太一、唯々諾々と服従いたす所存」
rows.en: “Faced with a demand straight out of a porn game, I, Taichi Kurosu, hereby pledge my wholehearted obedience.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "This Kurosu Taichi here intends to acquiescently submit even to a demand so incredibly Eroge-like as that!"

rows.jp: 「とりあえず霧ちんをいじめるの禁止ー」

ghs.en: Miki: "First of all, bullying Kiri-chin is now forbiddeeen!"
Miki: "Sexual harassment with love, as well."

rows.jp: 主従が逆転してしまった。
rows.en: Master and servant have traded places.

ghs.en: Complete turnabout of master and servant.

rows.jp: そんなわけで、学校にやってきた。
rows.en: That’s how we end up at school.

ghs.en: And with things being like that, we came to school.

rows.jp: 美希のおつきとして荷物持ちをさせられている。
rows.en: I’m stuck carrying Miki’s bags as her attendant.

ghs.en: I'm being made to carry Miki's bags as her escort.

rows.jp: 「さて、来たのはいいけど、どうすべー」

ghs.en: Taichi: "So then, we came here and that's OK, but whaddowedoo?"

rows.jp: 「あ、あっしはここで霧と合流しますんで」

ghs.en: Miki: "Ah, ah'm joining up with Kiri here."

rows.jp: 「ついでにこれも現像します」

ghs.en: Miki: "By the way, I'll be developing these as well!"

rows.jp: カメラを取り出し、不敵に笑う。
rows.en: She produces the camera with a wicked grin.

ghs.en: She takes out the camera and makes the toughest of laughs.

rows.jp: 「……ううっ、俺はおまえの愛奴隷だぁ」
軽い足取りで去っていった。

ghs.en: She went leaving with light steps.

rows.jp: 結局、学校に来てもやることはない。
rows.en: Even at school, I still have nothing to do.

ghs.en: And in the end, I may have gone to school but there was nothing to do.

rows.jp: けど……こんな悠長なことでいいのかな。
rows.en: But... can I really afford to take things this easy?

ghs.en: But... I wonder if being this leisurely is right.

rows.jp: 世界、滅亡しちゃってるのに。
rows.en: The world has ended, after all.

ghs.en: Because the world has fallen into ruin.

rows.jp: 俺は何をすべきなんだろう。
rows.en: What am I supposed to do?

ghs.en: I wonder what I ought to do.

rows.jp: 壮大な謎はいいけど、解く手がかりさえない。
rows.en: A grand mystery is one thing, but I don’t have a single clue to go on.

ghs.en: A grandiose riddle is fine to have, but clues to solve it I don't have.
Not true I don't have nothing.

rows.jp: 七香も、曜子ちゃんも言っていた。
rows.en: Nanaka and Youko have both mentioned it.

ghs.en: Nanaka and Youko-chan both mentioned it.

rows.jp: 暇見て、行ってみるのもいいかもな。
rows.en: Maybe I ought to go take a look when I get the chance.

ghs.en: I got spare time, maybe I should just go have a look, then.

rows.en: Hostility rolls off her in waves.

rows.jp: 「新学期初日から仲悪すぎる二人のため、この美希めが一計を」
rows.en: “Since you two have been at each other’s throats since the first day of the new term, I, Miki, have hatched a plan.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Dumb little Miki here has one proposal for these two people getting along so extremely bad from the very opening day of the new school term."
Taichi: "It's not bad between us, not really."

rows.jp: 「うーん……じゃ、やっぱり仲悪いということで。どうするの？」
rows.en: “Hmm... Then enemies it is. What’s your plan?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ohhh... well, then we're getting along bad after all. What do we do?"

rows.jp: 「部活？　友貴がやってるアレ？」
rows.en: “Club activities? That thing Tomoki is doing?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Club? That stuff that Tomoki's doing?"

rows.jp: 人類の形跡がなくなった世界で、俺たちは方針を決めた。
rows.en: In a world emptied of every trace of humanity, we decided what to do.

ghs.en: we had decided on our course of action in this world where all traces of mankind were no more.

rows.jp: 関係が断たれた者同士だ。
rows.en: We were people cut off from everyone else.

ghs.en: We are people whose relationships had been severed.

rows.jp: 他に道はなかったろう。
rows.en: There probably was no other choice.

ghs.en: There would never have been other ways.

rows.jp: その中で、友貴は食料の確保と配給、みみ先輩はアンテナを使ってＳＯＳを出す、という計画を立てた。
rows.en: Tomoki drew up plans to secure and ration food; Mimi would use the antenna to broadcast an SOS.

ghs.en: Within that, plans were made: Tomoki would secure and distribute food, while Mimi-senpai would use the antenna to send an SOS.

rows.jp: 合宿の結末は口論に彩られ、皆疲労していた。
rows.en: The camp ended amid arguments, with everyone exhausted.

ghs.en: The conclusion of the training camp was colored by quarrel, and everyone was weary.

rows.jp: だから二人に賛同する者はいなかった。
rows.en: So neither of them found any takers.

ghs.en: Therefore, there was no one who agreed with them.

rows.jp: 正直、最近の先輩は少しノイローゼ気味だった。
rows.en: To be honest, Mimi had seemed a little on edge lately.

ghs.en: Honestly, Senpai seemed a bit neurotic of late,

rows.jp: 俺が無理を言って強行した合宿が、そのトドメになった。
rows.en: The camp I’d forced through over everyone’s objections had been the final straw.

ghs.en: and the training camp I unreasonably forced on her became the finishing blow to that.

rows.jp: ……申し訳ない気持ちはあった。

ghs.en: ...I felt what I had done was inexcusable.

rows.jp: 話しかけづらいという気分も等しく。
rows.en: I felt just as reluctant to face her.

ghs.en: At least as much as it seemed that it would be hard to approach and talk to her.

rows.jp: 「命令です。仲良く部活をすること」
rows.en: “This is an order. Go do club activities together—and play nice.”

ghs.en: Miki: "This is an order. Let us get along together in the club."

rows.jp: まあ、いいか。異存はない。
rows.en: Fine by me. I have no objections.

ghs.en: Ah, whatever. I don't have objections.

rows.en: She smacks Kiri on the back.

rows.jp: コイツも弱みを握られているのかな。
rows.en: Does Miki have leverage on her too?

ghs.en: Is her weakness also being exploited then?

rows.jp: 「言うこときかないと……あの写真を張り出しちゃうぞ？」
rows.en: “If you don’t obey... maybe I’ll put those photographs on display.”

ghs.en: Miki: "If you don't do as I say... I will be posting up those photos, ya know?"

rows.jp: 「えと、屋上行って、手伝えばいいのかな？」
rows.en: “So we go to the rooftop and help?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Uhm, but is it OK if we just go to the rooftop and offer our help?"

rows.jp: 「そーです。穏やかに、荒ぶることなく」
霧は女子トイレに入った。
rows.en: Kiri goes into the women’s room.

rows.jp: 「……なにげなく入らないように」
rows.en: “...Don’t just wander in like it’s nothing.”

rows.jp: トイレと廊下の境界線で、俺と美希は分かたれた。
rows.en: The threshold between restroom and hall divides Miki and me.

ghs.en: I and Miki are separated by the boundary line between toilet and corridor.

rows.jp: 「霧ちんは嫌なことがあると引きこもるのです」
rows.en: “Whenever something upsets Kiri-kins, she shuts herself away.”

ghs.en: Miki: "When bad things happen, Kiri-chin goes hikikomori."

rows.jp: 「そういうわけで先に行っててください」

ghs.en: Miki: "And therefore, please go on ahead of us."

rows.jp: 「では美希にこれを授けよう」

ghs.en: Taichi: "But before that, I want you to have this, Miki."

rows.jp: 「小型のショットドライバーだ」
万年筆を半分に切ったほどのツール。
rows.en: About half as long as a fountain pen.

ghs.en: It was a tool the size of a a fountain pen cut in half.

rows.jp: 「ピッキングツールだ。役に立つぞ。小さいが耐久性がなくて、シアラインを揃える時にプレートが欠ける可能性がある。要注意だ」
rows.en: “It’s for picking locks. Useful little thing. Being so small makes it fragile, though—the pick blade can chip as you bring the pins to the shear line. Handle with care.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's lockpicking tool. It'll come in handy. It's small and it has no durability, so when you reach the shear line there is a possibility that the plate would get chipped. Handle with care."

rows.jp: 「趣味だ。普通の鍵なら慣れれば３０秒かからない」
rows.en: “It’s a hobby. With practice, I can open an ordinary lock in under thirty seconds.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Hobby. If you get good at it, a normal lock should take no more than 30 seconds."

rows.jp: 「そうか……こんな技術があるから……どこに隠れても無駄だったのか……」
rows.en: “I see... So that’s why hiding anywhere was useless...”

ghs.en: Miki: "Right... so with a skill like this... no matter where you hide it's pointless isn't it..."

rows.jp: 「いえー。とりあえずお借りします。いらないんですけどね……」
rows.en: “Nothing. I’ll borrow it for now. Not that I need it...”

ghs.en: Miki: "Nooothing. I will be taking it for now. Not that I need it, but..."

rows.jp: 「ちなみにキーピックは得意なのですか？」
rows.en: “By the way, are you good with a lockpick?”

ghs.en: Miki: "By the way, are you skilled with a lockpick?"

rows.en: “I can do it in my sleep.”
“Oh no... this guy is beyond saving...”
